ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. The skill requires this before every fix round. It decides who fixes and how the re-review runs.

ACTION: Read `docs/sync.md` around line 12 to check the target before I edit it.

ACTION: Edit `docs/sync.md` line 12, changing `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`. F1 is a one-file wording fix with no behavior change, so the skill lets me make it myself. If `fix-loop.md` says otherwise, I dispatch a fix subagent instead.

ACTION: Commit only `docs/sync.md`.

ACTION: List `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/` to find the Task 3 implementer report file. Append what I changed, that it changes no behavior, and that no test covers it.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package` for the fix commit range, to get the diff file path the re-review needs.

ACTION: Dispatch a scoped re-review on model `sonnet`, using `re-review-prompt.md`. The review is small and mechanical, so it stays at the standard tier. The prompt asks for an ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED verdict on F1, quoted verbatim, and for any new Critical or Important issue. It names the diff file path and the task's global constraints. It does not tell the reviewer what to skip.

Task 3 has one Important finding, F1: `docs/sync.md:12` says `--dry_run`, but the flag is `--dry-run`. I am fixing that one word myself and sending it to a scoped re-review. I will mark Task 3 complete only after the re-review comes back clean.
